name: Gol'Bolar Quarry Mine
summary: Troggs hold Gol'Bolar Quarry Mine, deep beneath Gol'Bolar Quarry in eastern Dun Morogh. Ironforge dwarves once worked its tunnels for stone and rich ore, until they broke into trogg caverns and the creatures overran the site. Hammerspine leads the warband in the deepest shafts.

sections.title: A Breach in the Deep
sections.body: Ironforge dwarves once mined stone and rich ore beneath Dun Morogh's craggy peaks. Their work ended when pickaxes broke through a wall into caverns inhabited by troggs. The creatures poured from the darkness, overwhelmed the crews, and drove them from the mine. Troggs then spread across the surrounding quarry pit.

sections.title: Lair of Hammerspine
sections.body: Younger, weaker troggs roam the quarry's sunlit terraces, while the mine shelters the warband's fiercest fighters. Hammerspine, their vicious chieftain, lurks deep in the cramped tunnels. Local mountaineers still need to reclaim the valuable quarry, but that means entering the mine's deepest reaches and cutting off the troggs at their source.

faq.q: Why is the mine full of troggs?
aliases: why are troggs in gol bolar
faq.answer: Dwarven miners broke into a hidden cavern as they dug. Troggs swarmed through the breach, slaughtered or drove out the miners, and claimed the shafts.

faq.q: Who leads the troggs inside Gol'Bolar Quarry Mine?
faq.answer: Hammerspine leads the troggs in Gol'Bolar Quarry Mine. The hulking brute commands the warband's strongest fighters deep in the shafts.

faq.q: Is the mine different from the rest of the quarry?
faq.answer: Yes. Weaker troggs roam the outer quarry pit, while the deep, cramped tunnels hold the toughest fighters and their chieftain.
No. Mining has stopped, and the site is now a battleground where dwarven mountaineers and adventurers try to drive out the troggs instead of gathering stone.

angles.text: Each pick swing into the mountain risks waking what lies beneath. Reclaiming Gol'Bolar Mine means restoring both its value and dwarven pride.
Hostile troggs still block the mine. Its deepest tunnels must be cleared before miners can return.
